fact: The article says there are ongoing efforts in the Uganda Police Force to develop an Electronic Policing Information System (ePIS) for digital records and document management and automation of policing processes, and treats integration of ePIS with the prosecution's PROCAMIS and the courts' ECCMIS as still to come; it describes no police case system in use at stations.
title: Experience and Impact of Digital Transformation in the Administration of Justice in Uganda: A Critical Analysis
